copy.tagline: Place the pieces, clear the lines.
copy.description: Pick one of three pieces, drop it on the grid and clear full rows and columns. The game ends when nothing fits. Looks calm, gets sweaty by minute ten.
controls: Drag one of the pieces below onto the grid.
Full rows and columns clear together; clearing several at once earns a bonus.
New pieces arrive once all three are placed; if none fits, the game ends.
